Tesla will wind down Cybertruck production at its Texas gigafactory around mid-2027, CEO Elon Musk has said, to make room for more Cybercab robotaxis. The move follows years of weak sales for a truck Musk once expected to sell 250,000 units a year.
So what happens to the Cybertruck now, how far did sales fall short of Musk's promise?
